stepAnswer: One or more of the features is a linear combination of other features.
stepTitle: Mir calculates $$\hat{\theta}$$ minimizing MSE, reruns OLS, and finds a different weight vector $$\hat{\theta}'$$ that yields the same MSE. He is confident this is the lowest possible MSE an OLS model can achieve. What is most likely the issue here?
stepBody: For the remainder of this question, Mir creates a new dataset; the new $$n$$ $$\times$$ $$p$$ design matrix is denoted $$X$$ and the targets are stored in $$Y$$. $$Assume$$ $$each$$ $$scenario$$ $$happens$$ $$independently$$ $$of$$ $$the$$ $$others$$.
choices: One or more of the features is a linear combination of other features.
$$\hat{Y}$$ is not a linear combination of the columns of $$X$$.
The prediction vector $$\hat{Y}$$ is not in the span of the design matrix.
The model does not have an intercept term.
